raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 9
Reason for Mistake: After discovering a clear conflict between sources (TIFF’s Canadian Film Encyclopedia showing St. John’s vs. multiple snippets showing Winnipeg), WebSurfer repeatedly relied on search-engine snippets and auto-generated summaries instead of opening and verifying the actual pages from authoritative sources. This failure to reconcile contradictory information and adjust strategy (e.g., by reading the Canadian Film Encyclopedia entry directly or seeking additional reputable bios/archives) led to perpetuating an unresolved and likely incorrect conclusion about the birthplace.
